IS 6226 : Part 1 : 2025 Recommendations of Apparatus for Chemical Analysis of Metals - Part 1 Apparatus for Determination of Carbon by Direct Combustion
ICS 77.180
ICS 77.180
MTD 34

1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 1) cover the recommends apparatus used for the determination of total carbon in metals ores and minerals by gravimetric and volumetric methods.
